select count(*) from talk_student s
and s.student_id in (select tsr.student_id from talk_student_record tsr join talk_session ts on tsr.session_id = ts.session_id where ts.create_by = #{counselorUsername}) and s.dept_id in (select dept_id from sys_dept d where (d.dept_id = #{secretaryDeptId} or find_in_set(#{secretaryDeptId}, d.ancestors)))

select s.*, d.dept_name, (select max(ts.talk_time) from talk_student_record tsr join talk_session ts on tsr.session_id = ts.session_id where tsr.student_id = s.student_id) as last_talk_time from talk_student s left join sys_dept d on s.dept_id = d.dept_id
and s.dept_id in (select d2.dept_id from sys_dept d2 where d2.dept_id = #{deptId} or find_in_set(#{deptId}, d2.ancestors))
and s.student_id not in ( select tsr.student_id from talk_student_record tsr join talk_session ts on tsr.session_id = ts.session_id where ts.talk_time between #{beginDate} and #{endDate} )
and s.student_id in (select tsr.student_id from talk_student_record tsr join talk_session ts on tsr.session_id = ts.session_id where ts.create_by = #{counselorUsername}) and s.dept_id in (select dept_id from sys_dept d where (d.dept_id = #{secretaryDeptId} or find_in_set(#{secretaryDeptId}, d.ancestors)))
order by s.student_code asc
SELECT IFNULL(MIN(t1.student_id + 1), 1) AS next_id FROM talk_student t1 LEFT JOIN talk_student t2 ON t1.student_id + 1 = t2.student_id WHERE t2.student_id IS NULL
select count(*) from talk_student_record where student_id = #{studentId}

select s.student_id, s.student_code, s.student_name, s.dept_id, s.gender, s.political_status, s.nation, s.phone, s.id_card, s.address, s.father_name, s.father_phone, s.mother_name, s.mother_phone, s.class_monitor, s.dorm_leader, s.dorm_building, s.dorm_room, s.enrollment_status, s.mental_health_status, s.poverty_level, s.remark, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, d.dept_name, (select max(ts.talk_time) from talk_student_record tsr join talk_session ts on tsr.session_id = ts.session_id where tsr.student_id = s.student_id) as last_talk_time from talk_student s left join sys_dept d on s.dept_id = d.dept_id
not exists ( select 1 from talk_student_record tsr join talk_session ts on tsr.session_id = ts.session_id where tsr.student_id = s.student_id and ts.talk_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime} )
and s.dept_id in (select d2.dept_id from sys_dept d2 where d2.dept_id = #{deptId} or find_in_set(#{deptId}, d2.ancestors))
and s.student_id in (select tsr.student_id from talk_student_record tsr join talk_session ts on tsr.session_id = ts.session_id where ts.create_by = #{params.counselorUsername}) and s.dept_id in (select dept_id from sys_dept d where (d.dept_id = #{params.secretaryDeptId} or find_in_set(#{params.secretaryDeptId}, d.ancestors)))
order by s.student_code asc

select s.mental_health_status as status, count(*) as cnt from talk_student s
s.mental_health_status is not null and s.mental_health_status != '' and s.mental_health_status != 'normal' and s.mental_health_status != '正常' and s.mental_health_status != '健康' and s.student_id in (select tsr.student_id from talk_student_record tsr join talk_session ts on tsr.session_id = ts.session_id where ts.create_by = #{counselorUsername}) and s.dept_id in (select dept_id from sys_dept d where (d.dept_id = #{secretaryDeptId} or find_in_set(#{secretaryDeptId}, d.ancestors)))
group by s.mental_health_status

select s.poverty_level as level, count(*) as cnt from talk_student s
s.poverty_level is not null and s.poverty_level != '' and s.poverty_level != 'none' and s.poverty_level != '无贫困' and s.poverty_level != '无' and s.student_id in (select tsr.student_id from talk_student_record tsr join talk_session ts on tsr.session_id = ts.session_id where ts.create_by = #{counselorUsername}) and s.dept_id in (select dept_id from sys_dept d where (d.dept_id = #{secretaryDeptId} or find_in_set(#{secretaryDeptId}, d.ancestors)))
group by s.poverty_level

select s.enrollment_status as status, count(*) as cnt from talk_student s
s.enrollment_status is not null and s.enrollment_status != '' and s.enrollment_status != 'active' and s.enrollment_status != '在读' and s.enrollment_status != '在校' and s.enrollment_status != '毕业' and s.student_id in (select tsr.student_id from talk_student_record tsr join talk_session ts on tsr.session_id = ts.session_id where ts.create_by = #{counselorUsername}) and s.dept_id in (select dept_id from sys_dept d where (d.dept_id = #{secretaryDeptId} or find_in_set(#{secretaryDeptId}, d.ancestors)))
group by s.enrollment_status
